Upper (when arms aren't resting). Band row 3×12 · Shoulder press 3×10 · Incline push-up 3×8–10 · Lateral raise 3×15 · Pull-apart 2×15.

Giving up for Lent
How dates are worked out
Ramadan and Eid use the tabular Islamic calendar (moon sighting can shift a day). Lent uses the Easter formula. Yom Kippur, Tisha B'Av, Navratri and Karva Chauth are from a table for 2026–2030 (Hindu dates are approximate; use the Fasting toggle for Ekadashi and others). Dawn and sunset are computed from your location with no internet.

What it's used for, and privacy
The coach answers what you type with your stats in view, drafts programme stages, estimates plates from photos, and can propose changes to goals or routines; nothing is applied until you tap Apply.

How to use Thrive

About

Thrive . Food, movement, water and habits in one place. No ads, and nothing is shared unless you choose to.

Data

Download a spreadsheet of everything you have logged. Reset log clears your days, weights and periods but keeps your settings, foods and recipes. Erase everything deletes all your Thrive data, including what is saved in your account, and starts again.

Backup & transfer

About this
Everything lives in this browser on this device. Updates keep it; clearing site data, a new phone or another browser doesn't, so switch on cloud backup. Back up to Drive, WhatsApp or email, then restore on the other side.
Remind me to back up
Every 2 weeks, on the Today tab

Circle

What this is
A small private group that sees each other's weekly points, whether each person logged today, and can send nudges. Needs a free Firebase project (15 minutes, once) whose config you paste below; friends then just enter your circle code. Only points, consistency, days moved, streak and a display name are shared. Nothing else leaves the phone.
Account
Without an account you're signed in anonymously and your circle membership lives on this phone only. With an email account you keep your circle across phones.

Recommended today

How training fits together
Move (exercise): one movement, like a squat, with cues and a demo.
Session (routine): a set of moves done together, 5–25 minutes. You can remove moves from any session.
Plan: which session each day this week, chosen from your style, goal, equipment, readiness and history. Change any day in Week ahead.
Programme: a multi-week aim (first pull-up, posture in 30 days) that steers which routines the plan suggests and only advances a stage when your logs prove it.
Classes and activities: anything you do outside the app, logged so it counts for calories, streaks and the circle.
